project.name: flamehaven-ledger-sanitizer
project.canonical_statement: Deterministic OPSEC/PII guard that scrubs local-workspace absolute paths and locale tokens from public-facing ledger files. Engine skeleton adapted from AI-SLOP-DETECTOR; runs as a standing pre-publish agent.

design_invariants.label: no-absolute-workspace-paths
design_invariants.statement: No published ledger file may contain a local-workspace absolute path. Any drive-letter or home path carrying a workspace marker (Sanctum, STRUCTURA, Users/dream) is collapsed to '[workspace]/<basename>'; if the path IS the workspace root, only '[workspace]' remains. Drive letter, OS, workspace codenames, username, and locale directories must all be removed.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-SAN-001: committed experiment JSON exposed D:\Sanctum\... absolute paths (drive, OS, workspace codenames, username) in a public repo — an information-disclosure / OPSEC failure.

design_invariants.label: no-locale-pii-tokens
design_invariants.statement: No published file may contain Hangul (Korean) runs. Residual Korean text in an English public ledger is a locale/content leak and is redacted to '[redacted]'. This catches locale-revealing folder names and untranslated content regardless of context.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-SAN-001: paths such as '...\000 (Korean research-folder)\X.pdf' leaked locale and internal research structure.

design_invariants.label: preserve-urls-and-relative-paths
design_invariants.statement: Sanitization must be marker-gated: only tokens carrying a workspace leak marker are rewritten. Public URLs (https://...), relative paths (./...), and code (JS regex literals, ternaries) must be left byte-for-byte unchanged. JSON files must remain valid after sanitization.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-SAN-002: an ungated drive-path regex matched the 's:' in 'https://' and would have corrupted every note hyperlink; fixed by gating replacement on workspace markers.

design_invariants.label: binary-artifacts-not-text-sanitizable
design_invariants.statement: Binary artifacts (e.g. .pdf) cannot be safely text-sanitized in place. A binary that contains a leak must be regenerated from already-sanitized source or removed from the published repo; it must never be shipped with embedded workspace paths.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-SAN-003: analysis_report.pdf embedded D:\Sanctum\... paths in its binary stream; removed from the repo since the sanitized .md/.html equivalents remain.

operation_meta.bootstrap_note: Sanitizer governance initialized after a repo-wide absolute-path/PII disclosure was found in committed experiment JSON. Adapted from AI-SLOP-DETECTOR engine pattern.
